Name: Giant Crop Fertilizer
Author: Atravita
TagLine: Adds a fertilizer that greatly increases the chances of giant crops. (Chance now configurable!)
Description:
This mod adds an end-game fertilizer that greatly boosts the chance of getting a giant crop (including basically guaranteeing it!). Simply apply to the middle of a 3x3 square of giant-crop eligible crops, wait for them to become full grown...

(Note: must be applied before the crops grow entirely.)

Okay....where do I get it?
Mr. Qi sells it for 5 Qi Gems each
Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download and unzip [Spacecore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348) and [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720), and unzip both into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Download and install [AtraCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932).

4.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

5.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Uninstall
Remove every instance of the giant crop fertilizer you have in your inventory and any chest, and then remove this mod from your Mods folder.

Configuration

*   [font=Courier New]GiantCropChance[/font] sets the chance a crop will grow big. Note: to ensure that the crop will become giant, probably best to set this slightly above [font=Courier New]1[/font], which is why the default is [font=Courier New]1.1[/font].

*   [font=Courier New]AllowGiantCropsOffFarm[/font] will allow giant crops off the farm. Note that [More Giant Crops](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263) will always allow giant crops off the farm, so if you have that mod installed, this configuration option will do nothing.
Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.

*   Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. In multiplayer, all players should install.

*   Should be compatible with most other mods. Tested with [MultiFertilizer](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7436), [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)'s giant crops and [More Giant Crops](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263). Should work with [DynamicGameAssets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365?tab=description) giant crops as well!

*   A small note: when MultiFertilizer is installed, the check that looks for whether or not a tile has already been fertilized doesn't quite work right with this fertilizer. Try to not accidentally apply two to the same square...
